title: 鋼軌閃光焊接~Flash-butt rail welding
focus: 電阻熱頂鍛幾何與焊接品質證據~Resistance heating upset geometry and weld-quality evidence
summary: 鋼軌閃光焊接以「電阻熱頂鍛幾何與焊接品質證據」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。閃光對焊把電熱輸入、接合面狀態與頂鍛塑性變形串接；焊後外觀平順只是幾何條件，不能單獨證明熱影響區與內部接合品質。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops resistance heating upset geometry and weld-quality evidence through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Flash-butt welding couples electrical heat input, interface condition and upset deformation; a smooth finished profile is a geometric condition and alone does not prove heat-affected-zone or internal bond quality. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把鋼軌閃光焊接放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。閃光對焊把電熱輸入、接合面狀態與頂鍛塑性變形串接；焊後外觀平順只是幾何條件，不能單獨證明熱影響區與內部接合品質。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Flash-butt rail welding in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Flash-butt welding couples electrical heat input, interface condition and upset deformation; a smooth finished profile is a geometric condition and alone does not prove heat-affected-zone or internal bond quality. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s；y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=6.05 kJ。模型邊界：電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=4 V, I=5000 A；y=V*I/1000=20 kW。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=22 kW。模型邊界：電壓只跨接頭且與電流同步；不含電纜及電源端損耗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s; y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.05 kJ. Boundary: Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=4 V, I=5000 A; y=V*I/1000=20 kW. Increasing only V with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 kW. Boundary: Voltage spans only the joint and is synchronous with current; cable and source losses are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.title: 電阻熱積分~Resistance-heat integration
units.mechanism: 焦耳熱與電流平方相關，電阻隨溫度和接觸狀態改變。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.05 kJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量。使用同步電流電壓波形作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Joule heat depends on current squared while resistance changes with temperature and contact state. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.05 kJ. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted. Use synchronized current and voltage waveforms as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s；y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=6.05 kJ。模型邊界：電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s; y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.05 kJ. Boundary: Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以同步電流電壓波形區分模型與觀察，先用合成高速電流與電壓訊號、同步時間窗及能量積分建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「電阻熱積分」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use synchronized current and voltage waveforms to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic high-rate current and voltage signals, synchronized intervals and energy integration, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Resistance-heat integration. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入。這個失效與「電阻熱積分」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同步電流電壓波形，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current. This failure and a measurement bias in Resistance-heat integration can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check synchronized current and voltage waveforms rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current.
units.practice: 重算「電阻熱積分」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入造成偏離的合成觀察，以同步電流電壓波形說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Resistance-heat integration, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current. Explain which evidence in synchronized current and voltage waveforms distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 電功率帳核對~Electrical power cross-check
units.title: 電功率帳核對~Electrical power cross-check
units.mechanism: 接頭電壓乘電流給出局部電功率，不能包含無關導線壓降。本模型把 V 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 22 kW。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。電壓只跨接頭且與電流同步；不含電纜及電源端損耗。使用接頭四線式電壓量測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Joint voltage times current gives local electrical power and must exclude unrelated cable drops. In this model, V is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 22 kW. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Voltage spans only the joint and is synchronous with current; cable and source losses are excluded. Use four-terminal voltage measurements across the joint as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.anchor: 頂鍛平均壓力~Mean upset pressure
units.title: 頂鍛平均壓力~Mean upset pressure
units.mechanism: 軸力除面積是平均頂鍛壓力，不等於接觸面每處應力。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 65.1316 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。力沿軸線且接觸面積固定；平均壓力不代表局部塑性應力分布。使用力位移同步曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Axial force divided by area is mean upset pressure, not local contact stress everywhere. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 65.1316 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Force is axial and contact area fixed; mean pressure does not represent local plastic stress distribution. Use synchronized force-displacement curves as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=65.1316 MPa。模型邊界：力沿軸線且接觸面積固定；平均壓力不代表局部塑性應力分布；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2; y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=65.1316 MPa. Boundary: Force is axial and contact area fixed; mean pressure does not represent local plastic stress distribution; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以力位移同步曲線區分模型與觀察，先用合成軸向力、接觸面積及接頭對中偏差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「頂鍛平均壓力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use synchronized force-displacement curves to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. units.title: 頂鍛作功估計~Upset-work estimate
units.mechanism: 近似定力作功是力乘行程，塑性熱與外部散熱仍須分帳。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1760 J。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。平均力在接頭有效行程內恆定；扣除機架彈性位移。使用行程零點與載荷作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Approximate constant-force work multiplies force by travel; plastic heat and external loss remain separate. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1760 J. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Mean force is constant over effective joint travel; frame elastic movement is excluded. Use travel zero and load as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=400 kN, d=4 mm；y=F*d=1600 J。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=1760 J。模型邊界：平均力在接頭有效行程內恆定；扣除機架彈性位移；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=400 kN, d=4 mm; y=F*d=1600 J. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=1760 J. Boundary: Mean force is constant over effective joint travel; frame elastic movement is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以行程零點與載荷區分模型與觀察，先用合成力位移曲線、機架回彈量與接頭相對行程建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「頂鍛作功估計」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use travel zero and load to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic force-displacement curve, frame recovery and relative joint travel, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. units.mechanism: 硬度差反映局部材料狀態，但不直接等同疲勞壽命差。本模型把 H1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 32 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩值使用同一硬度尺度和試驗條件；比例不換算疲勞壽命。使用等距硬度剖面與位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Hardness variation reflects local material state but does not directly equal a fatigue-life difference. In this model, H1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 32 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Values share one hardness scale and test conditions; the ratio is not converted into fatigue life. Use equally spaced hardness profiles and positions as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：H1=300 HV, H2=250 HV；y=(H1-H2)/H2*100=20 percent。只把 H1 增加百分之十，y=32 percent。模型邊界：兩值使用同一硬度尺度和試驗條件；比例不換算疲勞壽命；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: H1=300 HV, H2=250 HV; y=(H1-H2)/H2*100=20 percent. Increasing only H1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=32 percent. Boundary: Values share one hardness scale and test conditions; the ratio is not converted into fatigue life; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以等距硬度剖面與位置區分模型與觀察，先用同載荷壓痕硬度網格、位置及重複試驗建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「硬度相對差異」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use equally spaced hardness profiles and positions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using indentation-hardness grid at equal load, position records and repeat tests, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Relative hardness difference. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區。這個失效與「硬度相對差異」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查等距硬度剖面與位置，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone. This failure and a measurement bias in Relative hardness difference can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check equally spaced hardness profiles and positions rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone.
units.practice: 重算「硬度相對差異」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩值使用同一硬度尺度和試驗條件；比例不換算疲勞壽命如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區造成偏離的合成觀察，以等距硬度剖面與位置說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Relative hardness difference, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Values share one hardness scale and test conditions; the ratio is not converted into fatigue life. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone. Explain which evidence in equally spaced hardness profiles and positions distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 檢測覆蓋比例~Inspection coverage fraction
units.title: 檢測覆蓋比例~Inspection coverage fraction
units.mechanism: 幾何覆蓋比例描述檢測範圍，不能直接當成缺陷檢出機率。本模型把 covered 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 96.25 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。覆蓋與總長度是同一幾何量；未包含聲束靈敏度或檢出機率。使用探頭聲束覆蓋圖作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把覆蓋率當檢出率會誇大檢測能力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Geometric coverage describes inspection extent and is not probability of detection. In this model, covered is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 96.25 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Coverage and total length describe the same geometry; sensitivity and detection probability are excluded. Use probe beam-coverage maps as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Equating coverage with detection probability exaggerates inspection capability; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：covered=140 mm, total=160 mm；y=covered/total*100=87.5 percent。只把 covered 增加百分之十，y=96.25 percent。模型邊界：覆蓋與總長度是同一幾何量；未包含聲束靈敏度或檢出機率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: covered=140 mm, total=160 mm; y=covered/total*100=87.5 percent. Increasing only covered with a ten-percent increase gives y=96.25 percent. Boundary: Coverage and total length describe the same geometry; sensitivity and detection probability are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以探頭聲束覆蓋圖區分模型與觀察，先用標定試塊、探頭姿態及實際聲束覆蓋圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「檢測覆蓋比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use probe beam-coverage maps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using calibration blocks, probe pose and actual beam-coverage map, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Inspection coverage fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 把覆蓋率當檢出率會誇大檢測能力。這個失效與「檢測覆蓋比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查探頭聲束覆蓋圖，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Equating coverage with detection probability exaggerates inspection capability. This failure and a measurement bias in Inspection coverage fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check probe beam-coverage maps rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把覆蓋率當檢出率會誇大檢測能力~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equating coverage with detection probability exaggerates inspection capability.
units.practice: 重算「檢測覆蓋比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出覆蓋與總長度是同一幾何量；未包含聲束靈敏度或檢出機率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把覆蓋率當檢出率會誇大檢測能力造成偏離的合成觀察，以探頭聲束覆蓋圖說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Inspection coverage fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Coverage and total length describe the same geometry; sensitivity and detection probability are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Equating coverage with detection probability exaggerates inspection capability. Explain which evidence in probe beam-coverage maps distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
